heading: Terms
text:
## Terms [LFAC.11]

A **fact** is one instance of a schema: a value for each of its slots.
**Working memory** is the set of facts an engine holds live ([RARC.5.2.1]). An
**activation** is a rule together with the particular facts that matched it: a
firing owed until it fires, which stays, fired, while its match lasts ([LDET.5.3]).
